ProductsSections.faqDesc: Common queries regarding our products and operations.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for international shipments?
faqs.a: Our standard MOQ for international shipping is 1 FCL (Full Container Load), which typically holds around 20-25 tonnes depending on the packaging.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom particle sizes for Calcium Carbonate?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer custom milling and sizing based on your specific requirements ranging from coarse granules to ultra-fine powders.

faqs.q: Do you provide Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS)?
faqs.a: Absolutely. COA (Certificate of Analysis) and MSDS accompany every shipment and are available upon request during the inquiry phase.

faqs.q: How long is the typical lead time for an order?
faqs.a: For domestic orders, lead times are usually 3-7 days. For international exports, it depends on the destination and shipping schedules, typically 2-4 weeks.

ProductsSections.capScaleDesc1: With our expansive reserves and ongoing investments in state-of-the-art milling equipment, we have the capacity to scale operations rapidly to meet sudden increases in market demand.
ProductsSections.capScaleDesc2: Our continuous optimization of plant logistics ensures that peak production periods do not compromise the rigorous quality control standards our clients expect.

ContactSections.faqDesc: Find answers to the most common questions our clients ask.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get a quotation?
faqs.a: To get a quotation, simply fill out the contact form or message us on WhatsApp. Our sales team typically responds within 1-2 hours during business operations.
Yes, we handle FOB, CIF, and CFR shipments. Our logistics team will work closely with you to arrange the most efficient sea freight options.

faqs.q: Can I request product samples before ordering?
faqs.a: We provide product samples (up to 5kg) for lab testing. You only need to cover the international or domestic courier fees.

faqs.q: What payment terms do you accept?
faqs.a: For domestic orders, we accept bank transfers with standard terms. For international exports, we typically require T/T or Irrevocable L/C at sight.

faqs.q: Can I visit your mining site or processing facility?
faqs.a: Yes, we welcome prospect B2B partners. Please schedule a visit through our sales team at least 2 weeks in advance for safety and security clearance.
